@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+---
+title: "DocuSign"
+description: "DocuSign is a cloud-based e-signature platform that enables secure digital document signing and workflow automation."
+---
+
+DocuSign is a cloud-based e-signature platform that enables secure digital document signing and workflow automation.
+
+
+Categories: Productivity and Collaboration
+
+
+Type: docusign/v1
+
+<hr />
+
+
+
+## Connections
+
+Version: 1
+
+
+### oauth2_authorization_code
+
+#### Properties
+
+|      Name       |      Label     |     Type     |     Description     | Required |
+|:---------------:|:--------------:|:------------:|:-------------------:|:--------:|
+| clientId | Integration Key | STRING | `DocuSign app integration key.` | true |
+| clientSecret | Secret Key | STRING | `DocuSign app secret key.` | true |
+| accountId | API Account ID | STRING | `DocuSign API account ID.` | true |
+| environment | Environment | STRING <details> <summary> Options </summary> demo, www, eu </details> | `Environment of the connection.` | true |
+| baseUri | Account Base URI | STRING | `DocuSign account base URI.` | true |
+
+
+
+
+
+<hr />
+
+
+
+## Actions
+
+
+### Create Envelope
+Name: createEnvelope
+
+`Creates a new envelope.`
+
+#### Properties
+
+|      Name       |      Label     |     Type     |     Description     | Required |
+|:---------------:|:--------------:|:------------:|:-------------------:|:--------:|
+| documents | Documents | ARRAY <details> <summary> Items </summary> [{FILE_ENTRY\(documentFile), STRING\(name), INTEGER\(documentId)}\($document)] </details> | `The documents to be signed.` | true |
+| status | Status | STRING <details> <summary> Options </summary> sent, created </details> | `The status of the envelope.` | true |
+| emailSubject | Email Subject | STRING | `The subject of the email used to send the envelope.` | true |
+| signers | Signer Recipients | ARRAY <details> <summary> Items </summary> [{STRING\(name), STRING\(email), INTEGER\(recipientId)}\($recipient)] </details> | `The recipients of the envelope that have to sign the documents inside it.` | true |
+| carbonCopies | Cc Recipients | ARRAY <details> <summary> Items </summary> [{STRING\(name), STRING\(email), INTEGER\(recipientId)}\($recipient)] </details> | `The recipients of the envelope that can only view the documents inside it.` | false |
+
+#### Example JSON Structure
+```json
+{
+  "label" : "Create Envelope",
+  "name" : "createEnvelope",
+  "parameters" : {
+    "documents" : [ {
+      "documentFile" : {
+        "extension" : "",
+        "mimeType" : "",
+        "name" : "",
+        "url" : ""
+      },
+      "name" : "",
+      "documentId" : 1
+    } ],
+    "status" : "",
+    "emailSubject" : "",
+    "signers" : [ {
+      "name" : "",
+      "email" : "",
+      "recipientId" : 1
+    } ],
+    "carbonCopies" : [ {
+      "name" : "",
+      "email" : "",
+      "recipientId" : 1
+    } ]
+  },
+  "type" : "docusign/v1/createEnvelope"
+}
+```
+
+#### Output
+
+
+
+Type: OBJECT
+
+
+#### Properties
+
+|     Name     |     Type     |     Description     |
+|:------------:|:------------:|:-------------------:|
+| envelopeid | STRING | The id of the envelope. |
+| uri | STRING | A URI containing the user ID. |
+| statusDateTime | STRING | The DateTime that the envelope changed status (i.e. was created or sent.) |
+| status | STRING | Indicates the envelope status. |
+
+
+
+
+#### Output Example
+```json
+{
+  "envelopeid" : "",
+  "uri" : "",
+  "statusDateTime" : "",
+  "status" : ""
+}
+```
+
+
+### Download Envelope Document
+Name: downloadEnvelopeDocument
+
+`Downloads a single document or all documents from an envelope.`
+
+#### Properties
+
+|      Name       |      Label     |     Type     |     Description     | Required |
+|:---------------:|:--------------:|:------------:|:-------------------:|:--------:|
+| fromDate | From Date | DATE | `Envelops that were created from this date will be fetched.` | true |
+| envelopeId | Envelope ID | STRING <details> <summary> Depends On </summary> fromDate </details> | `The ID of the envelope.` | true |
+| documentId | Document ID | STRING <details> <summary> Depends On </summary> envelopeId </details> | `ID of the document that will be downloaded from the envelope.` | true |
+
+#### Example JSON Structure
+```json
+{
+  "label" : "Download Envelope Document",
+  "name" : "downloadEnvelopeDocument",
+  "parameters" : {
+    "fromDate" : "2021-01-01",
+    "envelopeId" : "",
+    "documentId" : ""
+  },
+  "type" : "docusign/v1/downloadEnvelopeDocument"
+}
+```
+
+#### Output
+
+
+
+Type: OBJECT
+
+

+
+
+Categories: Productivity and Collaboration
+
+
+Type: docusign/v1
+
+<hr />
+
+

+Version: 1
+

+
+#### Properties
+

+|:---------------:|:--------------:|:------------:|:-------------------:|:--------:|
+| clientId | Integration Key | STRING | `DocuSign app integration key.` | true |
+| clientSecret | Secret Key | STRING | `DocuSign app secret key.` | true |
+| accountId | API Account ID | STRING | `DocuSign API account ID.` | true |
+| environment | Environment | STRING <details> <summary> Options </summary> demo, www, eu </details> | `Environment of the connection.` | true |
+| baseUri | Account Base URI | STRING | `DocuSign account base URI.` | true |
+
+
+
+
+
+<hr />
+
+
+
+## Actions
+
+
+### Create Envelope
+Name: createEnvelope
+
+`Creates a new envelope.`
+
+#### Properties
+
+|      Name       |      Label     |     Type     |     Description     | Required |
+|:---------------:|:--------------:|:------------:|:-------------------:|:--------:|
+| documents | Documents | ARRAY <details> <summary> Items </summary> [{FILE_ENTRY\(documentFile), STRING\(name), INTEGER\(documentId)}\($document)] </details> | `The documents to be signed.` | true |
+| status | Status | STRING <details> <summary> Options </summary> sent, created </details> | `The status of the envelope.` | true |
+| emailSubject | Email Subject | STRING | `The subject of the email used to send the envelope.` | true |
+| signers | Signer Recipients | ARRAY <details> <summary> Items </summary> [{STRING\(name), STRING\(email), INTEGER\(recipientId)}\($recipient)] </details> | `The recipients of the envelope that have to sign the documents inside it.` | true |
+| carbonCopies | Cc Recipients | ARRAY <details> <summary> Items </summary> [{STRING\(name), STRING\(email), INTEGER\(recipientId)}\($recipient)] </details> | `The recipients of the envelope that can only view the documents inside it.` | false |
+
+#### Example JSON Structure
+```json
+{
+  "label" : "Create Envelope",
+  "name" : "createEnvelope",

+    "documents" : [ {

+        "extension" : "",

+      "name" : "",
+      "email" : "",
+      "recipientId" : 1
+    } ]
+  },

+
+
+

+
